about: The group chat's display names ([[REQ-357]]). The ONE place they are written.
Code, priming and surface text name ROLES — `consultant`, `coordinator` — and
never these strings, so renaming a participant is an edit here and nothing
else. They are what the room shows beside each contribution and what the
room's `names` map hands every member brief. `client` is how the person
using the builder sees their own contributions; `room` labels the notes the
room itself records (a participant skipped or declining).
`room` holds the budgets a new room is created with: the most member rounds
one exchange may take, and the most posts one participant may make in it.
